title: Separate the four V45 widths in the idle histogram
body:
## Summary
- A direct simplex recovers the parent idle histogram and the stage-1 idle histogram from the pinned stage certificate.
- Moving only the four V45 roles from width 8 to width 7 produces idle counts 234, 387/5, 75 and 1853/5. The idle rank mass rises by 36, one width on each of the nine calls.
- That vertex is the same at the recorded parent cap and the recorded stage-1 cap. The exact reduced-cost enclosure is not rebuilt, and there is no new exponent.
